description_zh: 删除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）
name: DeleteExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this request is only a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request and does not modify EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code that indicates whether the ECR instance was deleted. A value of 200 indicates that the deletion was successful. Any other value indicates that the deletion failed. For the cause of the failure, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断删除ECR实例是否成功。返回值为200表示创建成功，返回其他值表示创建失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace `%s` in the error message of the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the ECR instance was deleted. Valid values:
True: succeeded.
False: failed
Success.description_zh:
删除ECR实例是否成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
